subject.title: fix(acp): exec approvals target the matching concurrent prompt

question: Should ACP retain the stated invariant that every present `toolCallId` is authoritative even when the Gateway event also supplies a `runId`?
rationale: This is an authorization-routing contract: choosing between a run-first and an explicit-tool-call-first interpretation determines whether contradictory approval metadata may be relayed.

options.title: Require both identifiers to agree
options.body: Match the run only when it owns the requested execute tool call, otherwise fail closed; this preserves the PR’s stated security invariant.

options.title: Make runId authoritative
options.body: Retain the current run-first behavior and explicitly document that conflicting tool-call identifiers may be ignored.

recommendation.title: Require both identifiers to agree
recommendation.body: Match the run only when it owns the requested execute tool call, otherwise fail closed; this preserves the PR’s stated security invariant.

likelyOwner.reason: The current head commit and assignment show direct, recent ownership of this approval-routing follow-up.
